detail.longDescription:
OneCleaner is a practical utility tool.

Core Features:

1. Large File Manager
Find large files stored on your device, such as videos, photos, and archives. You can review these files and choose whether to keep or delete them.

2. Photo Management
Review photos on your device and find items that may take up storage space, such as duplicate or similar photos, if available.

3. Application Manager
View installed applications and their storage usage. You can open app details and manage apps through your device settings.

4. Device Information
View basic device information, including memory status, battery information, and network speed test results.

You can review our full Privacy Policy here:
https://sites.google.com/view/onecleanerpro/privacy-policy
